A negative sentiment score of -0.65 is assigned, reflecting these negative trends. A confidence score of 0.75 indicates that while some positive indicators exist, the significant negative impact on net income is a substantial cause for concern. Further investigation into the reasons behind this massive net income decrease is absolutely necessary.
